data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awwada’, meaning ‘to reunite’ or ‘to bring together’. In Islamic tradition, the name Muawidah is associated with the idea of unity and agreement, symbolizing harmony and understanding between people. It is also a name given to a girl in the Quran, known as Muawidah bint Abi Al-Jahsh, who was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
